# Arithmetic Intermediate Representation
Let all household items (🪥, 🛁, etc. ) be challenges, concretely evaluation points, supplied by the verifier.  Let all fruit & vegetables (🥝, 🥥, etc. ) be challenges, concretely weights to compress rows, supplied by the verifier.  Both types of challenges are X-field elements, i. e. , elements of Field p^3.<img alt="Field p^3." src="data:image/bmp;base64," />.
